request: Track customer complaints with a subject, the customer, the date received and a severity of low, medium or high. Complaints are Open, then Investigating, then Resolved.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Customer complaint" with 4 fields:
  - State (one of "Open", "Investigating", "Resolved", required)
  - Subject (text, required)
  - Date received (date)
  - Severity (one of "Low", "Medium", "High")
  It gets its own menu entry "Customer complaint" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Customer complaint records.
New optional link "Customer" from Customer complaint to Party. Choose it when creating a record.
New lifecycle for Customer complaint. Records start at "Open".
  - Start investigation changes "Open" to "Investigating" after confirmation.
  - Resolve changes "Investigating" to "Resolved" after confirmation.

Stored data: a new table, 2 new indexes, addForeignKey. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
